notes:
# BondoMod v0.2.14

- Add MMR Display as a permanent Basic plugin, directly below Platform Display. Choose a ranked mode, drag the transparent overlay, or adjust its position with X/Y sliders.
- Read your rating after Rocket League login and refresh it after completed matches. Keep session MMR change, wins, losses and streak across app, game and PC restarts; reset them only after confirmation.
- Fix scrolling in MMR settings and restore F2 focus monitoring independently of optional plugins.
- Improve spawned-item recognition using the local player's game telemetry, and preserve the selected team's loadout when restoring items after goals. Keep ambiguous or other-player loadouts protected.
- Improve automatic reset diagnostics with local equipped-item comparisons. Packet verification does not prove what the game rendered; affected users should retest match entry and goals.
- Remove session network hooks when Rocket League exits and avoid repeated elevation prompts during Launch RL. Show installer recovery details when an installation fails.
